messages.subject: Slate - internal plan
messages.plaintextBody:
Team,

Let's get the first draft subscription agreement and new articles out to Birchall Stone by end of next week. Elena to lead the SA and articles; James the IRA, side letter and disclosure. Watch the founder liability cap - Marcus is sensitive on that. Keep the cap table and funds flow tied to £55m / £4.4681 per share.

Sarah

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
